popupFileManager.title: Popup File Manager
popupFileManager.description: When enabled, the file manager button will be displayed in the command input bar, allowing you to open the popup file manager.

success.saved: Popup File Manager settings saved successfully.

error.saveFailed: Failed to save Popup File Manager settings.

timezone.title: Timezone Settings
timezone.description: Timestamps in notifications will be formatted according to this timezone.

popupEditor.title: Popup File Editor
popupEditor.enableLabel: Show popup editor when opening files
popupEditor.description: This setting also controls editor and preview close-cache behavior. When enabled, files open in the popup editor and the editor or preview close button clears all tabs and cached content in that workspace. When disabled, the popup editor is disabled and preview close buttons only hide while preserving cache. Clicking the blank backdrop or pressing Escape always only hides and preserves cache.

error.saveFailed: Failed to save popup editor setting.

shareEditorTabs.title: Editor Tabs
shareEditorTabs.enableLabel: Share editor tabs across all sessions
shareEditorTabs.description: If enabled, all SSH sessions will share the same set of open file editor tabs. If disabled, each session will have its own independent set of tabs.

success.saved: Editor tab sharing setting saved successfully.

error.saveFailed: Failed to save editor tab sharing setting.

docker.title: Docker Manager Settings
docker.refreshIntervalHint: How often to fetch Docker container status and stats (minimum 1).

error.invalidInterval: Refresh interval must be a positive integer.

statusMonitor.title: Status Monitor Settings
statusMonitor.refreshIntervalHint: How often to fetch server CPU, memory, disk, etc. status (minimum 1).

error.saveFailed: Failed to save status monitor settings.
error.invalidInterval: Refresh interval must be a positive integer.

workspace.title: Workspace & Terminal
workspace.sidebarPersistentDescription: When enabled, clicking outside the sidebar will not automatically collapse it.

success.showQuickCommandTagsSaved: Quick command tags visibility setting saved.
success.quickCommandsCollapsibleSearchSaved: Quick command search display setting saved.

error.showConnectionTagsSaveFailed: Failed to save connection tags visibility setting.
error.showQuickCommandTagsSaveFailed: Failed to save quick command tags visibility setting.
error.quickCommandsCollapsibleSearchSaveFailed: Failed to save quick command search display setting.

workspace.showConnectionTagsDescription: Disable to hide tags in the connection list and exclude them from search.
workspace.showQuickCommandTagsLabel: Show tags in quick command list
workspace.showQuickCommandTagsDescription: Disable to hide tags in the quick command list and exclude them from search.
workspace.quickCommandsCollapsibleSearchLabel: Collapse the search box into a search button by default
workspace.quickCommandsCollapsibleSearchDescriptio: Disabled by default. When enabled, the Quick Commands panel shows a search button until you click it to expand the search box.

spreadsheetPreviewLimits.title: Spreadsheet Preview
spreadsheetPreviewLimits.hint: Rows are paged so the full worksheet remains available. Higher page sizes and column limits use more browser memory.
spreadsheetPreviewLimits.saveFailed: Failed to save spreadsheet preview settings.
spreadsheetPreviewLimits.invalidRows: Rows per page must be an integer between 10 and 2000.
spreadsheetPreviewLimits.invalidColumns: Columns must be an integer between 5 and 200.

workspace.fileManagerShowDeleteConfirmationLabel: Confirm before deleting files or folders
workspace.fileManagerDeleteConfirmSuccess: File manager delete confirmation setting saved.
workspace.fileManagerDeleteConfirmError: Failed to save file manager delete confirmation setting.
workspace.terminalRightClickCopyPasteDescription: Right-click copies the current selection; when there is no selection, right-click pastes clipboard text.

statusMonitorShowIp.title: Status Monitor: Show IP Address
statusMonitorShowIp.enableLabel: Show IP address in status monitor

dashboardResources.title: Dashboard system resources
dashboardResources.description: Control whether the dashboard shows resource statistics for the Nexus host and active SSH hosts.
dashboardResources.localHint: Show CPU, memory, and root disk usage for the server running Nexus.
dashboardResources.remoteHint: Subscribe only to currently connected SSH sessions; offline hosts are not probed.
dashboardResources.refreshIntervalHint: Used only for dashboard SSH resource snapshots and kept separate from the status monitor interval.

error.saveFailed: Failed to save dashboard resource settings.
error.invalidInterval: SSH resource refresh interval must be an integer from 1 to 86400.

terminalScrollback.title: Terminal Scrollback Limit
terminalScrollback.limitHint: Set the maximum output history from 0 to 100000 lines. 0 uses the default 5000. This takes effect when the next terminal is opened.

success.saved: Terminal scrollback limit setting saved successfully.

error.saveFailed: Failed to save terminal scrollback limit setting.
error.invalidInput: Please enter an integer from 0 to 100000.

commandInputSync.title: Command Input Sync
commandInputSync.description: Sync the content of the command input bar to the search box of the selected panel in real-time. After selecting with the up/down keys, press Enter to execute the command.
